About 8 Ball Pool 2D

8-Ball Pool is a game you can play solo or with friends for as long as you like. Enjoy a robust simulation featuring precise ball physics and realistic spin animations, while exploring various features that let you challenge your friends. Choose from a variety of cue and pool table styles. Take your shot by pressing and holding the screen to adjust your power, and enjoy a realistic gaming experience.
